why: The official ExIFFI repository is cloned and includes the model implementation (model_reboot/EIF_reboot.py), the synthetic Bisect data (data/syn/bisect.csv), experiment scripts for the metric table, and the EIF+ eta code. The only expected work is creating a compatible Python environment on Windows/Python 3.12 and invoking the authors' scripts; no model, data, or core logic must be rebuilt.
blockers_seen: exiffi_env.yml is a conda environment likely pinned to older Python/numba/sklearn versions; may need a pip fallback on Python 3.12.
Launch scripts are bash .sh files and will not run directly on Windows; Python entrypoints must be invoked directly.
No GPU on this machine, but the Bisect Scenario II experiment is CPU-sized.

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: About 10-20 minutes total: roughly 5-10 minutes to install/repair dependencies, then under 5 minutes for 40 EIF+ and 40 EIF fits on the 1,100 x 6 Bisect dataset.

compute.basis: C1/C2 only require repeated EIF/EIF+ fits on the bundled 1,100-point, 6-feature Bisect dataset; each fit is seconds on CPU, with environment setup dominating the command time.
